narrative.overview:
The page alternates between two grounds taken from the two real rooms: Lugogo's butter-yellow walls for the quiet, light, centred sections, and Arena's canopy green for the immersive, full-bleed moments. Photographs carry the atmosphere; type carries the voice. Display type is Bodoni Moda at weight 500 in sentence case with authored line breaks; everything functional is Schibsted Grotesk. Corners are square or nearly so. There are no cards, no decorative shapes and no gradients except scrims that exist to keep type legible over photographs.

Motion is reserved for a few authored scenes rather than spread evenly: an opening where photographs stack in a small centred frame and the Arena canopy opens to full bleed, a pinned two-rooms scene, a horizontally travelling food gallery, words that fill with ink as the statement is read, and section seams that open from an inset panel so each change of ground is a movement, not a cut. Everything is visible without JavaScript and with reduced motion.

Density is low and the rhythm is generous: big vertical spacing on the light sections, viewport-height moments on the dark ones.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds only: butter (light, quiet) and canopy (immersive); gold and light belong to canopy.
Bodoni Moda 500, sentence case, tight tracking (-0.03em), authored two-line breaks.
Photographs in square-cornered frames (4px); the frame clips, the image inside moves.
Fill-sweep buttons and roll links are the only interactive flourishes.
Ground changes are revealed by clip-path seams, never by gradients.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: A section's background is canopy or butter, nothing else. Warm Light is ink, never ground.

rules.name: The Gold Stays Home Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only on canopy. On butter it has no contrast and no meaning.

rules.name: The Scrim Only Rule
rules.body: Gradients exist only as canopy-tinted scrims behind type on photographs (top, bottom, a centred radial behind a headline) and as masks that fade a photograph into canopy. No decorative gradients.

rules.name: The Authored Break Rule
rules.body: Display and headline text breaks where it was written, as block-level lines, not where the browser wraps. Headings also use `text-wrap: balance`.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Bodoni is always sentence case at weight 500. Uppercase belongs only to small Schibsted labels.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit flat. A shadow is permitted only on a floating overlay that covers a photograph.

dos: **Do** set every section on canopy or butter, and change ground with a seam reveal (clip from a 6% side inset to full) rather than a gradient.
**Do** keep gold and Warm Light text on canopy; on butter, ink is canopy at full or reduced opacity.
**Do** break display and headline text into authored sentence-case lines.
**Do** frame every photograph in a square-cornered (4px) clipping frame and animate the image inside it, not the frame's layout box.
**Do** use the motion tokens in `src/lib/motion` (power3.out, expo.out, power2.inOut, expo.inOut; 0.35/0.8/1.2/1.6s) and animate only transforms, opacity and clip-path.
**Do** keep every label on a fill at 4.5:1 or better in rest and hover states, including during the fill sweep.
donts: **Don't** use cards, rounded pills or decorative circles; the logo mark is the only round shape.
**Don't** add decorative gradients; scrims and photo fade masks are the only gradients.
**Don't** add shadows to sections, frames or buttons.
**Don't** put small uppercase labels or eyebrows above headings; uppercase is reserved for the hero's room labels and the "New" tag.
**Don't** use Warm Light as a section ground or gold on butter.
**Don't** hide content with CSS outside the hero's intro gate; without JavaScript or with reduced motion, every section is simply there.
